text: Choti Bachhi Ho Kya is a catchphrase that originated from the 2014 Bollywood movie Heropanti . The line is delivered by actor Tiger Shroff and entered memetic discourse in April 2014 after being parodied by Instagram comedian and mimicry artist Deependra Singh. The line "Choti bachhi ho kya" followed by "samajh nahi aata" translates to "Are you a little girl? Don't you understand?" The audio from Deependra Singh's parody has since become a catchphrase used used in lip-dub skits in various Instagram Reels, and the image of Tiger Shroff is often used as an exploitable .

On May 25th, 2014, the Bollywood movie Heropanti was released. The film was directed by Sabbir Khan and starred Tiger Shroff. The movie contained a scene where Tiger Shroff scolds his co-star Kirti Samon by saying, "Choti bachhi ho kya? Samajh nahi aata?" The scene can be viewed via a reupload to YouTube [1] and has gathered over 1.5 million views since April 3rd, 2022 (seen below). On April 5th, 2021, comedian Deependra Singh's YouTube [2] channel DS ENTERTAINMENT posted a YouTube Short impersonating Tiger Shroff's delivery of the line in the aforementioned scene. The video gathered over 8.4 million views and 600,000 likes in a year and a half since its upload (seen below).

The sound later went viral on Instagram Reels in April 2022. A compilation of Instagram videos using the sound can be accessed via reupload to YouTube [3] on April 21st, 2022 (seen below). [This video has been removed] In a press event promoting Heropanti 2 on April 22nd, 2022, Tiger Shroff delivered the dialogue on stage, referencing the memes .
